2. Interest rates on savings accounts are typically higher at credit unions. By how much? Maybe 0.1% to 0.3% more, which on $120 per cycle amounts to pennies, but that's the principle of not being gouged by corporations.

1. Use Markdown files stored in a shared Dropbox folder — yes, Dropbox, you'll hate it, but it's the only thing that won't corrupt when someone's Surface tries to sync with their ancient MacBook.
2. Set up a Git repo with GitHub Desktop for the people who know what Git is, and a "drag and drop" folder for everyone else — this is not ideal, but it's reality.
3. Use Pandoc to convert everything to PDF weekly so the group can read it on any device without fighting formatting demons.
